hostedRed.failure: Seven desktop1920 native-input/capture journeys exceeded existing budgets; no golden mismatch.

environment: Local Linux, Node22.23.2, Chromium, single CI worker; ordinary available CPU affinity, three consecutive repeats. No timeouts, retries, assertions, snapshots or supported profiles changed. Test fixture durations, not production frame timings.
driverCorrection: Shared linear Gunsmith focus uses real Left/Right shortest wrap; family Down/Up checks retained.
Controller uses actual D-pad polling with press/release samples on shortest wrapping path.
Desktop pointer journeys use real wheel reveal and click rather than prerequisite keyboard traversal.
Existing freeze/resume seam only around PNG encoding; finally resumes before later live input/resize/save assertions.

limitations: Hosted runner remains authoritative; local repeats do not replace full local and exact-head CI.
Two-CPU affinity experiments remained slower than observed hosted cold-ready/input timings and timed out before/after correction; they are not a calibrated CI proxy or a new acceptance gate.
CPUs0,1 share a physical core; separate-core0,2 experiment was also uncalibrated. No production performance inference from either experiment.
Menu scrolling already uses one content-container mask; per-object masking hypothesis was rejected without runtime changes.
